title: HikeNation Zip, Dip & Row
summary: A four-hour Chaguaramas adventure combining canopy zip-lining, kayaking and a snorkelling stop from TT$325 per person for groups of four or more.
description: HikeNation's Zip, Dip & Row combines a canopy zip-line tour, kayaking lesson and coastal paddling with a snorkelling beach stop. Adventure guides, activity instructors and safety gear are included. Meet at 9:45 am for a 10:00 am start. Transportation to the Chaguaramas meeting point is not included.
